Package com.example.projecteventlotteryapp

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.projecteventlotteryapp.Event
public class Event extends Object
Model for an Event

This class models an event entity stored in Firebase Firestore. It stores metadata such as registration dates, draw date, attendee limits, organizer information, and lists of entrants. Instances of this class are used to help display database information.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event(String name, LocalDate registrationStartDate, LocalDate registrationEndDate, LocalDateTime drawDate, int attendeesLimit)
      Creates a new Event object with basic event information.

      This constructor is typically used when creating a new event before it has been stored in the database.

      Parameters:
      name - name of the event
      registrationStartDate - the date when event registration opens
      registrationEndDate - the date when event registration closes
      drawDate - the date and time when the lottery draw occurs
      attendeesLimit - the maximum number of entrants that can attend the event

    • Event

      public Event(String eventId, String name, LocalDate registrationStartDate, LocalDate registrationEndDate, LocalDateTime drawDate, int attendeesLimit)
      Creates an Event object that corresponds to an existing Firestore document.

      This constructor initializes the event with a known event ID and creates a reference to the associated Firestore document.

      Parameters:
      eventId - the unique identifier of the event document in Firestore
      name - the name of the event
      registrationStartDate - the date when event registration opens
      registrationEndDate - the date when event registration closes
      drawDate - the date and time when the lottery draw occurs
      attendeesLimit - the maximum number of entrants that can attend the event

    • entrantListContains

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Boolean> entrantListContains(EntrantListType listType, User entrant)
      Checks whether a specific entrant exists in one of the event's entrant lists.

      This method retrieves the event document from Firestore and checks if the entrant's user ID exists in the specified list.

      TODO: Consider turning into a query instead of fetching the eventDoc
      Parameters:
      listType - the entrant list to check
      entrant - the user whose membership in the list is being checked
      Returns:
      a Task that resolves to true if the entrant exists in the list, or false otherwise
